name: Bambu Printer
author: Zhruoshui
description: Bambu Lab printer status in the bar: print progress, remaining time, temperatures and layer info over LAN MQTT, reusing the access code stored by Bambu Studio.

barWidget.description: Live print status from a Bambu Lab printer on the LAN: progress and remaining time in the bar, temperatures and layer info in the popup. One widget per printer.

schema.label: Printer serial number
schema.description: 15-character SN, e.g. 00M09C3A0801234. Shown in Bambu Studio under printer settings.

schema.label: Printer IP address
schema.description: LAN IP of the printer, e.g. 192.168.1.42. Find it in Bambu Studio's device page or your router.

schema.label: Display name
schema.description: Optional friendly name shown in the panel. Falls back to the last 4 digits of the SN.

schema.label: Access code
schema.description: Leave empty to read it from Bambu Studio's config automatically.

schema.label: Show while idle
schema.description: Keep the bar widget visible even when the printer is idle or offline.
